description: Source code for the class 'AudioEndpointParcelable' which manages parcelable audio endpoint data, including shared memory, message queues, and data queues, for Android's AAudio system.

classes.name: AudioEndpointParcelable
classes.description: Parcelable wrapper for audio endpoint data, managing shared memory, message queues, and data queues for Android AAudio.

methods.name: AudioEndpointParcelable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parcelable object from an Endpoint rvalue reference.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator to move an Endpoint into the parcelable object.

methods.name: parcelable
methods.description: Converts the parcelable object into an Endpoint structure, re-indexing shared memories.

methods.name: addFileDescriptor
methods.description: Adds a file descriptor to shared memory table, returning its index.

methods.name: closeDataFileDescriptor
methods.description: Closes and releases file descriptors associated with data shared memories.

methods.name: updateDataFileDescriptor
methods.description: Updates data file descriptors based on another parcelable endpoint, managing shared memory indices.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves message queues and data queue descriptors from shared memories.

methods.name: resolveDataQueue
methods.description: Resolves data queue descriptor from shared memories.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all shared memories and releases resources.

methods.name: getNextAvailableSharedMemoryPosition
methods.description: Finds the next free position in shared memory array.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs debug information about shared memories and message/data queues.
